A '''fonwim''' was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] found on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="GCG" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|ithorian|Ithorian}}</ref> "Fonwim" was also a family name for Ithorians.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fonwim gemstone was mentioned in the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', which was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
